title: Unused Workspace Licenses
dataSources: Renewal calendar events (`calendar:event`), Rocket Money subscriptions (`rocketmoney:subscription`), Stripe invoices (`stripe:invoice`), and Google Workspace licenses (`googleworkspace:license`).
app: Renewal calendar exports, Rocket Money subscriptions, Stripe invoice history, and Google Workspace license data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=googleworkspace:license assigned_seats=* active_seats=*
| eval unused_seats=assigned_seats-active_seats
| where unused_seats>0
| sort - unused_seats
description: Surfaces license pools where assigned or purchased seats exceed genuinely active usage.
value: Unused licenses are one of the cleanest recurring SaaS savings opportunities because the fix is straightforward.
implementation: Ingest seat assignment and recent activity data from the Google Workspace Admin SDK and compare the totals per SKU.
visualization: Table of SKUs with assigned, active, and unused seats.
grandmaExplanation: It counts where you are paying for software seats that nobody is really using.
